video_title: Is James Harden KILLING the Cavaliers?

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: James Harden's alarming decline in decision-making and turnovers
quotes.excerpt: He still had more turnovers than he had field goals made. Why is that continuing to happen?
quotes.quote: What's the difference in LeBron doing this at 41? I don't think LeBron goes out there and play like that. Now, they're two different levels, for sure. But LeBron is 41. James is only 37 and he's looking for more money. If you're going to get paid, guys, they only had to make maybe a couple more shots. He still had more turnovers than he had field goals made. Why is that continuing to happen?

quotes.speaker: D-Will
quotes.summary_phrase: Physical decline impacting James Harden's on-court performance
quotes.excerpt: He's 37 and you can tell he lost a step. When you start losing a step and losing your quickness, it's hard.
quotes.quote: He's 37 and you can tell he lost a step. When you start losing a step and losing your quickness, it's hard. He's not getting into his. You see he the pity-pat step back. He's doing it, but it ain't the same and then he goes to step back, he ain't got the same lift as he did two or three years ago. Especially this late in the season. He's not a guy who's been ultra-phenomenal shape his whole career. I feel like that's the thing as you get older, you almost got to get in better shape than you were when you were younger. And I don't see that with him.

quotes.speaker: D-Will
quotes.summary_phrase: Cavaliers' critical error: not giving Donovan Mitchell the ball
quotes.excerpt: He's your young guy, he's your number one. Why the ball is not in your young star's hand?

text_blocks.speaker: D-Will
text_blocks.text: Why is the ball not in Donovan Mitchell's hand at the end of the game? He's your young guy, he's your number one. Honestly, James is number two on this team. He's your number one. Why the ball is not in your young star's hand? Especially when he starts turning the ball over.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: That shit made no sense to me. Donovan was coming down court. I understand he hit the shot the play before. So it was 99-99. James does a spin move mid-range jump shot. It's tied game 101 all. And then Donovan has the ball, James goes and gets the ball. Donovan's like, no, I got it. James goes and gets it and then Sarra Merrill's taking the last shot.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: I get it. The ball needs to be in Donovan Mitchell's hand.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: The ball needs to be in Donovan Mitchell's hand.

text_blocks.speaker: D-Will
text_blocks.text: You got to rock with your superstar. I don't give a fuck. Give the ball to your guy and go take his zone. Period. And we lose that way because that's how New York's going to go. New York's following Jalen Brunson. At the end of the game, the ball is in whose hand for the New York Knicks? Jalen Brunson. Take us home. And you make the decision if you want to pass it.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Cavaliers' Game 1 collapse: a psychological blow
quotes.excerpt: That psychologically could kill the Cavs. Being up 22 points and losing that game.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: That psychologically could kill the Cavs. Being up 22 points and losing that game. That was the game they had to get. We had just talked about them going seven games, not having the energy. They had the energy. They came out with the energy. That's the game they had to win. Guys, when you got a team that has been off for a week, there is apparent rust. It was obvious. The Knicks, I don't know if the Knicks are going to play any worse than they did. It's hard to say that, right? So at the end of the day, you have to win that game. And you were up 22 points. The Knicks shot like shit. The only person that had it going was who? Brunson.

text_blocks.speaker: D-Will
text_blocks.text: That's what everybody's saying, they don't know if they're going to bounce back.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Cavaliers squandered crucial Game 1 win in New York
quotes.excerpt: If you are going to win the series, you know you have to win one in New York. And that was the one that you had to win.
quotes.quote: If you are going to win the series, you know you have to win one in New York. And that was the one that you had to win. 22 points? Because guess what? If you get up again like that, psychologically what are you going to start thinking? It's going to get tense. Dudes ain't going to know what to do and you can't sit here and say the Cavs aren't tired. They just played two seven-game series. So my thing is, you got to sit here and look in the mirror and understand that you lost an opportunity. You got to do the best you can to bounce back in Game 2. They're talking about Donovan got to go supernova in Game 2. The guy played well yesterday.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson must lead Knicks' scoring against Cavaliers
quotes.excerpt: I think this is the series that Jalen Brunson, you need to lead us. You need to be the focal point.
quotes.quote: Y'all three have been a part of playoff series and played. So y'all know each series is different. I think this is a different series. I don't think Karl-Anthony Towns needs to be the focal point. You know why? Because they have two bigs that can guard Karl-Anthony Towns. So this series, to me, and this is my opinion, I think this is the series that Jalen Brunson, you need to lead us. You need to be the focal point. We're putting the pressure on you now to make those decisions. The series before, Atlanta, the mismatch was Karl-Anthony Towns. The next series, the mismatch was Karl-Anthony Towns because Joel Embiid couldn't move. This series, they have guys that can move with Karl-Anthony Towns. Cleveland don't got nobody can fuck with Jalen Brunson. Nobody can guard him. So if you can get the matchup you want, this is the series Mikal Bridges, OG Anunoby, Shammet, McBride, all these guys, this is your time to sit here and go make plays and open it up for Karl-Anthony Towns. Jordan Clarkson.

quotes.speaker: D-Will
quotes.summary_phrase: Western Conference poised to win NBA championship
quotes.excerpt: Somebody on the West is going to win this shit. Because the East don't look good. Let's keep it a buck.
quotes.quote: Somebody on the West is going to win this shit. Because the East don't look good. Let's keep it a buck. The Knicks or Cleveland, are they really a championship team? Come on. They're going to win the championship against those monsters on the West? I got money on it already. So if it happens, you know it's not happening, right? Do you really think the Knicks and Cleveland, honest question. Do you really think the Knicks and Cleveland can beat San Antonio four times or Oklahoma four times?

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Knicks' team construction empowers Jalen Brunson's success
quotes.excerpt: The construction of the Knicks team gives them a chance. And that goes for every guard that's like that.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: I'm not saying that's every team, though.

text_blocks.speaker: Hong
text_blocks.text: No, because there's a clear gap between some. Steph to Andrew Wiggins. Like there's a clear gap. You see what I'm saying? Like I don't think like I do believe if they match up against OKC, Karl-Anthony Towns will have to be just as good as Jalen Brunson to win. I don't and that's what I mean by like a clear guard can't be your defined number one.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: That makes sense. The construction of the Knicks team gives them a chance. And that goes for every guard that's like that. The team around Jalen Brunson helps him prevail.
